During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled '''bathysphere''' was assigned to operations in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of a [[Unidentified Jovian planet|Jovian]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]. Its design included a control cabin with a wheel to steer the vessel, and an aft section where the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] were housed. Its hull was not rated to withstand 1,000 atmospheres worth of pressure.<ref name="RPG" />

The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] boarded the vessel at one point, and neutralized the crew except for a [[Unidentified Imperial (bathysphere)|single member]]. The two fought for control of the vessel, until the repulsors gave out. Garnet managed to fix them, but the Imperial planned to shoot the smuggler despite having been saved by him.<ref name="RPG" />
